question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting(Y/N) and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and the average department budget code within each school, along with the subject title, total units, dense rank over the department code ordered by department code, and the number of subjects offered by the department, for each subject offered by the Mathematics department, ordered by department name and dense rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, dept_subject_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN (SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sos2.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos2 ON d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) dept_subject_counts ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average, range, and variance of the number of supervisees for all space units associated with that department, and also include the total square footage and the total research volume for each department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT AS department_name, AVG(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS avg_supervisees, MAX(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) - MIN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_range, VARIANCE(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS supervisee_variance FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance, SUM(SSU.SQFT) AS total_sqft, SUM(SSU.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM inner_cte JOIN SPACE_UNIT SU ON inner_cte.department_name = SU.SPACE_UNIT JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE SSU ON SU.DLC_KEY = SSU.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY inner_cte.department_name, inner_cte.avg_supervisees, inner_cte.supervisee_range, inner_cte.supervisee_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.supervisee_range DESC

question: For Mathematics subjects in academic year 2024, show each subject code, subject title, total units, and the average total units within its department. Include only subjects with non-null total units and order by subject code.
SQL:
SELECT ccs.SUBJECT_CODE,ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE,ccs.TOTAL_UNITS,AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS_DEPT
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccs
WHERE ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2024'AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%'AND ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ccs.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic year in academic_terms_all, show the academic year, academic year description, number of terms, first term start date, and last term end date. Exclude rows with null academic year and order by academic year.
SQL:
SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(TERM_CODE) AS number_of_terms, MIN(TERM_START_DATE) AS first_term_start_date, MAX(TERM_END_DATE) AS last_term_end_date
FROM academic_terms_all
WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school in sis_department, show the school name, number of departments, number of degree-granting departments, and average department budget code. Include only schools with at least 2 departments.
SQL:
SELECT SCHOOL_NAME,COUNT(DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS number_of_departments,SUM(CASE WHEN IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_of_degree_granting_departments,AVG(CAST(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS UNSIGNED)) AS average_department_budget_code
FROM sis_department
GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME
HAVING COUNT(DEPARTMENT_CODE) >= 2;

question: For each degree-granting department, show the department code, department name, school name, clearing cost collector, and department budget code by joining sis_department to sis_admin_department on department code. Exclude rows where clearing cost collector is null.
SQL:
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
FROM sis_department AS d
JOIN sis_admin_department AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR IS NOT NULL;

question: For each department in subject_summary, show the department name, count of subjects, average total units, variance of total units, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units for term '2022FA'. Include only subjects with total units greater than 0.
SQL:
SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME,COUNT(SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count,AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_total_units,STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
FROM subject_summary
WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA'AND TOTAL_UNITS > 0
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each offer department in library_subject_offered during term '2014FA', show the department name, number of library subjects, average enrolled students, minimum enrolled students, and maximum enrolled students. Include only departments with at least 3 library subjects.
SQL:
SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS department_code,OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,COUNT(*) AS number_of_library_subjects,AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS average_enrolled_students,MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS minimum_enrolled_students,MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS maximum_enrolled_students
FROM library_subject_offered
WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA'
GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

question: For each IAP sponsor type, show the sponsor type, number of activities, average attendance, and maximum attendance for non-cancelled IAP activities with non-null attendance.
SQL:
SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE,COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS number_of_activities,AVG(CAST(d.ATTENDANCE AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS average_attendance,MAX(CAST(d.ATTENDANCE AS UNSIGNED)) AS maximum_attendance
FROM iap_subject_detail d
JOIN iap_subject_sponsor s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED IS NULL OR d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N'AND d.ATTENDANCE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE;

question: For IAP activities with session information, show the activity title, session title, session date, session start time, session end time, and person name. Exclude cancelled activities and order by session date and start time.
SQL:
SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, sess.SESSION_TITLE, sess.SESSION_DATE, sess.SESSION_START_TIME, sess.SESSION_END_TIME, pers.PERSON_NAME
FROM iap_subject_detail AS iap
JOIN iap_subject_session AS sess ON iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_person AS pers ON iap.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = pers.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED <> 'Y'
ORDER BY sess.SESSION_DATE, sess.SESSION_START_TIME;

question: For each building in fclt_building, show the building number, building name, number of rooms, assignable area, and average room area from fclt_rooms. Include only rooms with positive area.
SQL:
SELECT b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.NUM_OF_ROOMS, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, AVG(r.AREA) AS AVG_ROOM_AREA
FROM fclt_building AS b
JOIN fclt_rooms AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE r.AREA > 0
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.NUM_OF_ROOMS, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA;

question: For each major room use in fclt_rooms, show the major use description, number of rooms, total area, average area, variance of area, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of area. Include only rooms with area greater than 100.
SQL:
SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC,COUNT(*) AS number_of_rooms,SUM(AREA) AS total_area,AVG(AREA) AS average_area,VARIANCE(AREA) AS variance_area,STDDEV(AREA) AS stddev_area
FROM fclt_rooms
WHERE AREA > 100
GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC;

question: For each floor in each fclt building, show the building key, floor, assignable area, non-assignable area, and the percent of gross area that is assignable. Exclude floors with null or zero gross area.

For each employee department in employee_directory, show the department name, number of employees, number with office phone, and number with email address. Include only departments with at least 5 employees.
SQL:
SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME,DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,COUNT(*) AS num_employees,COUNT(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_PHONE <> '' THEN 1 END) AS num_with_office_phone,COUNT(CASE WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL_ADDRESS <> '' THEN 1 END) AS num_with_email_address
FROM employee_directory
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5;

question: For each HR organization unit title in drupal_employee_directory, show the organization unit title, number of employees, number with additional appointment, and number with dual appointment.
For each student department in mit_student_directory, show the department name, student year, and count of students. Include only rows where department name and student year are not null.
SQL:
SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS student_count
FROM mit_student_directory
WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND STUDENT_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, STUDENT_YEAR;

question: For each degree type in student_degree_program, show the degree type, degree type description, number of degree programs, minimum degree weight, maximum degree weight, and average degree weight. Exclude rows with null degree type.
SQL:
SELECT DEGREE_TYPE, DEGREE_TYPE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS number_of_degree_programs, MIN(DEGREE_WEIGHT) AS min_degree_weight, MAX(DEGREE_WEIGHT) AS max_degree_weight, AVG(DEGREE_WEIGHT) AS avg_degree_weight
FROM student_degree_program
WHERE DEGREE_TYPE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DEGREE_TYPE, DEGREE_TYPE_DESC;

question: For each department and course level in student_degree_program, show the department, course level, and number of programs. Include a rollup total by department using GROUP BY WITH ROLLUP.

For each course catalog HASS attribute, show the HASS attribute, HASS attribute description, number of subjects, and average total units. Include only subjects offered this year with non-null total units.
SQL:
SELECT c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,COUNT(*) AS number_of_subjects,AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_total_units
FROM cis_course_catalog AS c
WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'AND c.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC;

question: For each department in cis_course_catalog, show the department name, count of subjects offered in the fall term, count offered in the spring term, and count offered in IAP.
For each subject in course_catalog_subject_offered that meets with another subject, show the subject code, subject title, department name, meets-with subjects, and total units for academic year 2024.
For each subject grouping in subject_grouping, show the term code, department code, department name, school name, and number of groupings. Include only term '2022FA'.
SQL:
SELECT TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS NUMBER_OF_GROUPINGS
FROM subject_grouping
WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each subject in subject_offered_summary for term '2022FA', show subject id, subject title, offer department name, total units, number of enrolled students, and the enrollment difference from the department average enrollment.

For each offer school in subject_offered_summary during term '2022FA', show the school name, total subjects, total enrolled students, average enrolled students, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students.
SQL:
SELECT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students,AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS average_enrolled_students,STDDEV(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS stddev_enrolled_students
FROM subject_offered_summary
WHERE TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
GROUP BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each term in subject_summary, show the term code, number of subjects, total fifth-week credit enrollment, total fifth-week listener enrollment, and average total units. Include only subjects with positive total units.
SQL:
SELECT TERM_CODE,COUNT(SUBJECT_ID) AS number_of_subjects,SUM(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT) AS total_fifth_week_credit_enrollment,SUM(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN) AS total_fifth_week_listener_enrollment,AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_total_units
FROM subject_summary
WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > 0
GROUP BY TERM_CODE;

question: For each subject in subject_summary for term '2022FA', show subject id, subject title, department name, subject enrollment first week, subject enrollment fifth week, and the change from first week to fifth week.
For each library course instructor department, show the department, number of instructors, number of reserve material records, and number of distinct catalog titles.
SQL:
SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT,COUNT(DISTINCT lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) AS number_of_instructors,COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY) AS number_of_reserve_material_records,COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS number_of_distinct_catalog_titles
FROM library_course_instructor AS lci
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog AS lrc ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT
ORDER BY lci.DEPARTMENT;

question: For each TIP material publisher, show the publisher, number of materials, average new shelf price, average used shelf price, and average rental used price. Include only materials with non-null publisher.
SQL:
SELECT publisher,COUNT(*) AS number_of_materials,AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price,AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_shelf_price,AVG(RENTAL_USED_PRICE) AS avg_rental_used_price
FROM tip_material
WHERE publisher IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY publisher;

question: For each TIP subject in term '2022FA', show subject id, subject title, offer department name, count of associated material records, and total record count from tip_detail.
SQL:
SELECT   tso.SUBJECT_ID,  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,  COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_record_count,  COALESCE(SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT), 0) AS total_record_count
FROM   tip_subject_offered AS tso
LEFT JOIN   tip_detail AS td  ON tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WHERE   tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA'
GROUP BY   tso.SUBJECT_ID,  tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,  tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME;

question: For each building room in space_detail, show the building room, room name, room square footage, space unit, and space usage by joining space_detail to space_unit and space_usage.
SQL:
SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, su.SPACE_UNIT, sug.SPACE_USAGE
FROM space_detail AS sd
LEFT JOIN space_unit AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
LEFT JOIN space_usage AS sug ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sug.SPACE_USAGE_KEY;

question: For each space usage, show the usage name, number of rooms, total room square footage, average room square footage, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of room square footage.
SQL:
SELECT   su.SPACE_USAGE,  COUNT(sd.ROOM_NUMBER) AS number_of_rooms,  SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_room_square_footage,  AVG(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS average_room_square_footage,  STDDEV(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS stddev_room_square_footage
FROM   space_detail AS sd
JOIN   space_usage AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
GROUP BY   su.SPACE_USAGE
ORDER BY   su.SPACE_USAGE;

question: For each building in buildings, show the building number, building name, gross square footage, assignable square footage, and assignable percentage. Exclude rows with null or zero gross square footage.
For each major use in fac_rooms, show the major use description, number of rooms, average area, minimum area, and maximum area for rooms with area greater than 0.
SQL:
SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC,COUNT(*) AS number_of_rooms,AVG(AREA) AS average_area,MIN(AREA) AS minimum_area,MAX(AREA) AS maximum_area
FROM fac_rooms
WHERE AREA > 0
GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC;

question: For each top-level HR organization name, show the organization name, number of HR units, and number of distinct DLC names from hr_org_unit.
SQL:
SELECT HR_ORG_LEVEL1_NAME AS top_level_hr_organization_name,COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS number_of_hr_units,COUNT(DISTINCT DLC_NAME) AS number_of_distinct_dlc_names
FROM hr_org_unit
GROUP BY HR_ORG_LEVEL1_NAME
ORDER BY HR_ORG_LEVEL1_NAME;

question: For each faculty roster administrative organization, show the administrative organization title, number of faculty, number with endowed chair, and number with emeritus status.
SQL:
SELECT HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS administrative_organization_title,COUNT(*) AS number_of_faculty,SUM(CASE WHEN ENDOWED_CHAIR IS NOT NULL AND ENDOWED_CHAIR <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_with_endowed_chair,SUM(CASE WHEN EMERITUS_STATUS IS NOT NULL AND EMERITUS_STATUS <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS number_with_emeritus_status
FROM hr_faculty_roster
GROUP BY HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
ORDER BY HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE;

question: For each warehouse user unit, show the unit id, unit name, user type, appointment type, and number of users. Include only rows with non-null unit id.
SQL:
SELECT UNIT_ID, UNIT_NAME, TYPE, APPOINTMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS number_of_users
FROM warehouse_users
WHERE UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY UNIT_ID, UNIT_NAME, TYPE, APPOINTMENT_TYPE;

question: For each subject code in sis_subject_code, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, and number of rows for Mathematics department only.
SQL:
SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_rows
FROM sis_subject_code
WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each department in course_catalog_subject_offered, show the department name, number of variable-unit subjects, number of non-variable-unit subjects, and total number of subjects for academic year 2024.
SQL:
SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME,SUM(CASE WHEN IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS variable_unit_subjects,SUM(CASE WHEN IS_VARIABLE_UNITS <> 'Y' OR IS_VARIABLE_UNITS IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_variable_unit_subjects,COUNT(*) AS total_subjects
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2024'
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each department and grade type description in course_catalog_subject_offered, show the department name, grade type description, count of subjects, and average total units for academic year 2024. Include only rows with non-null total units.
SQL:
SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE_DESC, COUNT(SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2024'AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE_DESC;

question: For each academic year in academic_terms_all, show the academic year, academic year description, and number of rows, including only non-null academic years.
SQL: SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM academic_terms_all WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each school in sis_department, show the school name and number of departments, including only non-null school names.
SQL: SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS department_count FROM sis_department WHERE SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY department_count DESC, SCHOOL_NAME;

question: For each building in buildings, show the building number, building name, gross square footage, assignable square footage, and assignable percentage, excluding buildings with null or zero gross square footage.
SQL: SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, BUILDING_NAME, BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, (BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE / BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) * 100 AS assignable_percentage FROM buildings WHERE BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NOT NULL AND BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE <> 0 ORDER BY assignable_percentage DESC, BUILDING_NUMBER;

question: For each major use description in fclt_rooms, show number of rooms, total area, average area, variance of area, and standard deviation of area using STDDEV, considering only rooms with area greater than 100.
SQL: SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS room_count, SUM(AREA) AS total_area, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, VARIANCE(AREA) AS variance_area, STDDEV(AREA) AS stddev_area FROM fclt_rooms WHERE AREA > 100 GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY total_area DESC, MAJOR_USE_DESC;

question: For each department in employee_directory, show the department name, department number, number of employees, number with office phone, and number with email address.
SQL: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_PHONE <> '' THEN 1 END) AS employees_with_office_phone, COUNT(CASE WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL_ADDRESS <> '' THEN 1 END) AS employees_with_email FROM employee_directory WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY employee_count DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each student department and student year in mit_student_directory, show the department name, student year, and number of students, excluding null department names and null student years.
SQL: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM mit_student_directory WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND STUDENT_YEAR IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, STUDENT_YEAR;

question: For each degree type in student_degree_program, show the degree type, degree type description, number of programs, minimum degree weight, maximum degree weight, and average degree weight.
SQL: SELECT DEGREE_TYPE, DEGREE_TYPE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS degree_program_count, MIN(DEGREE_WEIGHT) AS min_degree_weight, MAX(DEGREE_WEIGHT) AS max_degree_weight, AVG(DEGREE_WEIGHT) AS avg_degree_weight FROM student_degree_program WHERE DEGREE_TYPE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEGREE_TYPE, DEGREE_TYPE_DESC ORDER BY degree_program_count DESC, DEGREE_TYPE;

question: For each warehouse user unit, show the unit id, unit name, type, appointment type, and number of users, excluding null unit ids.
SQL: SELECT UNIT_ID, UNIT_NAME, TYPE, APPOINTMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM warehouse_users WHERE UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY UNIT_ID, UNIT_NAME, TYPE, APPOINTMENT_TYPE ORDER BY UNIT_NAME, TYPE, APPOINTMENT_TYPE;

question: For each department in employee_directory, show the department name, department number, total number of employees, percentage of employees with an office phone, and percentage of employees with an email address, excluding null department names.
SQL: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN OFFICE_PHONE IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_PHONE <> '' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS office_phone_percentage, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND EMAIL_ADDRESS <> '' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS email_percentage FROM employee_directory WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY employee_count DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each student department in mit_student_directory, show the department name, number of distinct student years represented, and total number of students, excluding null department names and null student years.
SQL: SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS student_year_count, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM mit_student_directory WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND STUDENT_YEAR IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each warehouse user unit, show the unit id, unit name, total number of users, number of distinct user types, and number of distinct appointment types, excluding null unit ids.
SQL: SELECT UNIT_ID, UNIT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT TYPE) AS distinct_type_count, COUNT(DISTINCT APPOINTMENT_TYPE) AS distinct_appointment_type_count FROM warehouse_users WHERE UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY UNIT_ID, UNIT_NAME ORDER BY user_count DESC, UNIT_NAME;
